yutu.stdout:
yutu is a CLI, MCP server, and AI agent that automates your YouTube workflows from the terminal or any AI client.

Environment variables:
  YUTU_CREDENTIAL    Path/Base64/JSON of OAuth client secret (default: client_secret.json)
  YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN   Path/Base64/JSON of cached OAuth token (default: youtube.token.json)
  YUTU_ROOT          Root directory for file resolution (default: current working directory)
  YUTU_LOG_LEVEL     Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR (default: INFO)

Usage:
  yutu [flags]
  yutu [command]

Available Commands:
  abuseReport            Manage YouTube abuse reports
  activity               Manage YouTube activities
  agent                  Start an agent to automate YouTube workflows
  auth                   Authenticate with YouTube APIs
  caption                Manage YouTube video captions
  channel                Manage YouTube channels
  channelBanner          Manage YouTube channel banners
  channelSection         Manage YouTube channel sections
  comment                Manage YouTube comments
  commentThread          Manage YouTube comment threads
  completion             Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help                   Help about any command
  i18nLanguage           Manage YouTube i18n languages
  i18nRegion             Manage YouTube i18n regions
  liveBroadcast          Manage YouTube live broadcasts
  liveChatBan            Manage YouTube live chat bans
  liveChatMessage        Manage YouTube live chat messages
  liveChatModerator      Manage YouTube live chat moderators
  liveStream             Manage YouTube live streams
  mcp                    Start MCP server
  member                 Manage YouTube channel members
  membershipsLevel       Manage YouTube membership levels
  playlist               Manage YouTube playlists
  playlistImage          Manage YouTube playlist images
  playlistItem           Manage YouTube playlist items
  search                 Manage YouTube search
  subscription           Manage YouTube subscriptions
  superChatEvent         Manage YouTube Super Chat events
  thirdPartyLink         Manage YouTube third-party links
  thumbnail              Manage YouTube video thumbnails
  version                Show the version of yutu
  video                  Manage YouTube videos
  videoAbuseReportReason Manage YouTube video abuse report reasons
  videoCategory          Manage YouTube video categories
  watermark              Manage YouTube watermarks

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for yutu

Use "yutu [command] --help" for more information about a command.

yutu abuseReport.stdout:
Manage YouTube abuse reports. Use this tool to report abusive content on YouTube.

Usage:
  yutu abuseReport [flags]
  yutu abuseReport [command]

Available Commands:
  insert      Create an abuse report

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for abuseReport

Use "yutu abuseReport [command] --help" for more information about a command.

yutu abuseReport insert.stdout:
Create an abuse report. Use this tool to report abusive content on YouTube such as spam, harassment, or violent content.

Usage:
  yutu abuseReport insert [flags]

Examples:
# Report a video as spam
yutu abuseReport insert --abuseTypes spam --subjectId VIDEO_ID --subjectTypeId video --description "This video is spam"
# Report a comment as harassment
yutu abuseReport insert --abuseTypes harassment --subjectId COMMENT_ID --subjectTypeId comment --description "Harassment in comment"

Flags:
  -a, --abuseTypes strings       Abuse type IDs (e.g., spam, harassment)
  -d, --description string       Description of the abuse
  -h, --help                     help for insert
  -o, --output string            json|yaml|silent
  -p, --parts strings            Parts to include (default [snippet])
  -r, --relatedEntityId string   ID of a related entity
  -s, --subjectId string         ID of the subject being reported
  -t, --subjectTypeId string     Type ID of the subject (e.g., video, comment, channel)
  -u, --subjectUrl string        URL of the subject being reported
      --yes                      Confirm the operation

yutu activity.stdout:
Manage YouTube activities. Use this tool to list channel activities.

Usage:
  yutu activity [flags]
  yutu activity [command]

Available Commands:
  list        List activities

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for activity

Use "yutu activity [command] --help" for more information about a command.

yutu activity list.stdout:
List activities. Use this tool to list activities such as uploads, likes, and favorites.

Usage:
  yutu activity list [flags]

Examples:
# List my activities
yutu activity list --for mine
# List activities by channel ID with limit
yutu activity list --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --maxResults 10
# List activities after a date in JSON format
yutu activity list --publishedAfter 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z --output json

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string         ID of the channel
  -F, --for string               home|mine
  -h, --help                     help for list
  -n, --maxResults int           The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -o, --output string            json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings            Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet,contentDetails])
  -a, --publishedAfter string    Filter on activities published after this date
  -b, --publishedBefore string   Filter on activities published before this date
  -r, --regionCode string        Display the content as seen by viewers in this country

yutu agent.stdout:
Start an agent to automate YouTube workflows.

Usage:
  yutu agent [flags]

Examples:
# Gemini(compatible) (default)
yutu agent --provider google --model gemini-3.8-flash --api-key "YOUR_KEY"
yutu agent --provider google --model gemini-3.8-flash --api-key "YOUR_KEY" --base-url "https://custom.endpoint.com/"
# OpenAI(compatible) (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama, vLLM, etc.)
yutu agent --provider openai --model gpt-5.6-terra --api-key "YOUR_KEY"
yutu agent --provider openai --model deepseek-flash --api-key "YOUR_KEY" --base-url "https://api.deepseek.com/"

Flags:
      --api-key string       API key for the model provider
  -a, --args string          Launcher arguments as a single string (default "console")
      --base-url string      Base URL for the model provider's API endpoint
  -h, --help                 help for agent
  -i, --instruction string   Override the built-in agent instruction
  -m, --model string         Model name (default "gemini-3.8-flash")
  -p, --provider string      LLM provider: google for Gemini(compatible), openai for OpenAI(compatible) (default "google")

yutu auth.stdout:
Authenticate with YouTube APIs to access and manage YouTube resources.

Usage:
  yutu auth [flags]

Flags:
  -t, --cacheToken string   Path to token cache file, or Base64 encoded string, or JSON string (env: YUTU_CACHE_TOKEN) (default "youtube.token.json")
  -c, --credential string   Path to client secret file, or Base64 encoded string, or JSON string (env: YUTU_CREDENTIAL) (default "client_secret.json")
  -h, --help                help for auth

yutu caption.stdout:
Manage YouTube video captions. Use this tool to list, insert, update, download, or delete video captions.

Usage:
  yutu caption [flags]
  yutu caption [command]

Available Commands:
  delete      Delete captions
  download    Download a caption
  insert      Upload a caption
  list        List captions
  update      Update a caption

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for caption

Use "yutu caption [command] --help" for more information about a command.

yutu caption delete.stdout:
Delete captions. Use this tool to delete captions of a video by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu caption delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a caption by ID
yutu caption delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple captions
yutu caption delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help                            help for delete
  -i, --ids strings                     IDs of the captions to delete
  -b, --onBehalfOf string               ID of the YouTube account that the content owner is acting on behalf of
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
      --yes                             Confirm the operation

yutu caption download.stdout:
Download a caption. Use this tool to download a caption from a video.

Usage:
  yutu caption download [flags]

Examples:
# Download a caption as SRT
yutu caption download --id abc123 --file subtitle.srt
# Download a caption as VTT
yutu caption download --id abc123 --file subtitle.vtt --tfmt vtt
# Download a caption translated to French
yutu caption download --id abc123 --file subtitle.srt --tlang fr

Flags:
  -f, --file string                     Path to save the caption file
  -h, --help                            help for download
  -i, --id strings                      ID of the caption to download
  -b, --onBehalfOf string               ID of the YouTube account that the content owner is acting on behalf of
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -t, --tfmt string                     sbv|srt|vtt
  -l, --tlang string                    Translate the captions into this language

yutu caption insert.stdout:
Upload a caption. Use this tool to upload a caption to a video.

Usage:
  yutu caption insert [flags]

Examples:
# Insert a caption to a video
yutu caption insert --file subtitle.srt --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ
# Insert a caption with language and name
yutu caption insert --file subtitle.srt --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --language en --name English
# Insert a standard caption and publish immediately
yutu caption insert --file subtitle.srt --videoId dQw4w9WgXcQ --trackKind standard --isDraft=false

Flags:
  -a, --audioTrackType string           unknown|primary|commentary|descriptive (default "unknown")
  -f, --file string                     Path to save the caption file
  -h, --help                            help for insert
  -A, --isAutoSynced                    Whether YouTube synchronized the caption track to the audio track in the video (default true)
  -C, --isCC                            Whether the track contains closed captions for the deaf and hard of hearing
  -D, --isDraft                         whether the caption track is a draft
  -E, --isEasyReader                    Whether caption track is formatted for 'easy reader'
  -L, --isLarge                         Whether the caption track uses large text for the vision-impaired
  -l, --language string                 Language of the caption track
  -n, --name string                     Name of the caption track
  -b, --onBehalfOf string               ID of the YouTube account that the content owner is acting on behalf of
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|silent
  -t, --trackKind string                standard|ASR|forced (default "standard")
  -v, --videoId string                  ID of the video
      --yes                             Confirm the operation

yutu caption list.stdout:
List captions. Use this tool to list captions of a video.

Usage:

  -p, --parts strings                   Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet])

yutu channel.stdout:

yutu channel list.stdout:

yutu channel list --for mine

yutu comment.stdout:
Manage YouTube comments. Use this tool to list, create, update, delete, mark as spam, or set moderation status for comments.

Usage:
  yutu comment [flags]
  yutu comment [command]

Available Commands:
  delete              Delete comments
  insert              Create a comment
  list                List comments
  markAsSpam          Mark comments as spam
  setModerationStatus Set comment moderation status
  update              Update a comment

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for comment

Use "yutu comment [command] --help" for more information about a command.

yutu comment delete.stdout:
Delete comments. Use this tool to delete comments by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu comment delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a comment by ID
yutu comment delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple comments
yutu comment delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for delete
  -i, --ids strings   IDs of comments
      --yes           Confirm the operation

yutu comment insert.stdout:
Create a comment. Use this tool to create a comment on a video.

Usage:
  yutu comment insert [flags]

Examples:
# Reply to a comment
yutu comment insert --channelId UC_x5X --videoId dQw4w9 --authorChannelId UA_x5X --parentId UgyXXX --textOriginal 'Hello'
# Reply with rating enabled
yutu comment insert --channelId UC_x5X --videoId dQw4w9 --authorChannelId UA_x5X --parentId UgyXXX --textOriginal 'Reply' --canRate

Flags:
  -a, --authorChannelId string   Channel id of the comment author
  -R, --canRate                  Whether the viewer can rate the comment
  -c, --channelId string         Channel id of the video owner
  -h, --help                     help for insert
  -o, --output string            json|yaml|silent
  -P, --parentId string          ID of the parent comment
  -t, --textOriginal string      Text of the comment
  -v, --videoId string           ID of the video
      --yes                      Confirm the operation

yutu comment list.stdout:
List comments. Use this tool to list comments by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu comment list [flags]

Examples:
# List replies to a comment
yutu comment list --parentId UgyXXXXXXXX --maxResults 10
# List specific comments in JSON format
yutu comment list --ids abc123,def456 --output json
# List a comment in plain text
yutu comment list --ids abc123 --textFormat plainText

Flags:
  -h, --help                help for list
  -i, --ids strings         IDs of comments
  -n, --maxResults int      The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -o, --output string       json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -P, --parentId string     Returns replies to the specified comment
  -p, --parts strings       Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet])
  -t, --textFormat string   textFormatUnspecified|html|plainText (default "html")

yutu completion bash.stdout:
Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(yutu completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	yutu completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/yutu

#### macOS:
